_about: One-off checks run during the session, not part of the pipeline (work/libsvm_pre.py, kept local). Each tests a hypothesis behind a cause in results.json.

official_libsvm_srand1_chem.hypothesis: The paper's digits come from the official LIBSVM C library with C rand() seeded afresh for every model (one svm-train process per model, glibc seed 1), which the Platt fit's internal 5-fold split draws from.
official_libsvm_srand1_chem.test: libsvm-official 3.37 (the C library), precomputed RBF kernel (-t 4 -c 2 -b 1), srand(1) before every svm_train, on the paper's folds; chem feature set.
official_libsvm_srand1_chem.result: rejected: as far from the paper as scikit-learn's libsvm with other seeds

rf_seed_1.hypothesis: RF's gap to Table 3 is the random forest's own randomness (WEKA's trees cannot be replayed in scikit-learn).
rf_seed_1.test: scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier, 100 trees, 13 features per split, random_state 1 (the pipeline uses 0), full feature set, the paper's folds (work/algos2.py).
rf_seed_1.result: inconclusive: seeds 0 and 1 differ by 0.0002 in AUC; the paper is 0.0003 to 0.0013 higher
